rejection_resampling.CLI: rank chosen first; no retry on invalid generate; CLI loops offsets for mathematical fingerprint dedup only. No statistical conditioning observed in 204 independently selected attempts.

learner_selection.implementation: faithful database-free transcription of SHA256 draw and sorted unique candidates in question_selection.rs::select; all candidates moderate
learner_selection.weights: Any positive moderate weight yields uniform selection within the eligible moderate pool; zero moderate weight with no unrated entries yields no question. Unconfigured policy deterministically returns lowest entity ID.
learner_selection.history: seen_before_task removes earlier tasks; caller also excludes current prefix. Exhausted inventories can leave any proper subset of this batch, preserving its shortcut.
learner_selection.limits: Actual learner histories, active policy and future database IDs are not captured. These are explicit scenarios, not claims about a live learner.
